name: On-site congress and event production
shortDescription: We film at the congresses where cardiology meets. KOL interviews, physician presentations, booth content and social clips, captured on your stand while the people who matter are in the room.
whyThisMatters:
On-site congress and event production means bringing a film crew to a medical congress, such as TCT, to capture content on your stand while your key opinion leaders, physicians and leadership team are all in one place.

A congress is the one moment in the year when your KOLs are a few steps from your stand. A dedicated filming booth turns that moment into a library of interviews, presentations and social content, recorded in a few days rather than chased over months.

We know the clinical language and how to brief a busy interventional cardiologist between sessions. That is what lets us film fast without putting your KOL relationships, or your reputation, at risk.
outcomesMainTitle: What you leave the congress with
outcomesDescription: One shoot, content for the months that follow.
outcomesFirstDescription: Single and two-person interviews with your key opinion leaders, physicians and leadership team, filmed on multiple cameras and ready to cut for every channel.
outcomesSecondDescription: Short-form content with physicians, made for social media and captured alongside the main interviews.
outcomesThirdDescription: B-roll of the stand, team photography and recordings of physician presentations, so the congress can be retold long after it ends.

process.title: Plan
process.text: Before the congress we agree the interview list, questions and schedule with your team, so every KOL knows what we need from them.

process.title: Set up on the stand
process.text: We build a dedicated, multi-camera filming booth on your stand, so interviews happen between sessions without anyone leaving the booth.

process.title: Film, always on
process.text: We film throughout the congress, so no opportunity is missed when a physician has ten minutes free or a presentation draws a crowd.

process.title: Edit and deliver
process.text: After the event we cut the footage into interviews, presentations and social clips for your website, channels and sales team.

deliverables: B-roll of the stand and the congress
Edited films and clips for every channel

faqs.question: What is on-site congress and event production?
faqs.answer: It is filming at a medical congress or event, usually from a dedicated booth on your stand, to capture interviews with key opinion leaders, physicians and your leadership team, plus presentations, B-roll, photography and social content, while everyone is in one place.

faqs.question: Which congresses do you film at?
faqs.answer: We film at European and US cardiology congresses on our clients' stands, most recently TCT 2026 with Shockwave Medical, now part of Johnson & Johnson.

faqs.question: Who do you interview?
faqs.answer: Key opinion leaders, physicians and members of your leadership team, in single or two-person interviews filmed on multiple cameras. We also film physician presentations around the stand.

faqs.question: How do you work with KOLs on a busy congress day?
faqs.answer: KOL relationships take years to build, and we treat them accordingly. We brief each physician in advance, keep interviews tight, and fit around their sessions, which is why we run an always-on booth rather than fixed slots.

faqs.question: What happens to the footage after the congress?
faqs.answer: We edit it into interviews, presentation films and short social clips, ready for your website, social channels, sales team and future campaigns. Many clients use one congress to build content for the months that follow.

faqs.question: Can you combine congress filming with other content?
faqs.answer: Yes. We also create congress and event creative, VR experiences for the booth, and live webinars, so the stand and the content work together. Read why VR works at the booth.
